note: Declared receiver directed acyclic graph: receiver path -> shared stage -> implementing symbols -> protecting suites.
A static call graph cannot recover these conceptual stages, so this file is the
authoritative mapping. tools/explorer/explorer_contract.py verifies every symbol
against the analyzer's symbol table and every suite key against suites.json
(exported from test/runtests.jl), so a renamed function or a dropped suite fails
loudly instead of leaving the chain page stale.
kind: shared = infrastructure both baselines also use; initial = runs once to produce
the initial candidate; iterative = inside a receiver refinement loop;
deployment = frame-stateful wrapping of a receiver.
evidence: direct = at least one declared suite textually names a stage symbol
(contract-enforced against the coverage scan); behavioral = the declared suites
exercise the stage through the public API without naming internals - rendered
as declared-only on the coverage page, never as a direct reference.

edges.condition: valid initial candidate: return without refinement
improved invalid candidate and iterations remain

stages.title: Packet acquisition
stages.detail: LFM synchronization, initial resampling, and partial-FFT views.

stages.title: One-tap pilot-interpolated equalization + FEC
stages.detail: Pilot-interpolated one-tap equalization produces the OFDM+FEC candidate and FEC result, with no partial-FFT combining or refinement.

stages.title: Partial-FFT/FEC initial candidate
stages.detail: Pilot-trained per-band combining computes the Partial-FFT/FEC initial candidate. The OFDM+FEC result is also computed, and candidate selection keeps the better result. Lite returns a valid initial candidate without refinement.

stages.title: Posterior means and confidences
stages.detail: Belief-propagation posterior log-metrics become symbol decisions and per-carrier confidences.

stages.title: Anchor selection
stages.detail: Pilots always anchor; confident data decisions join up to the anchor cap. These arms replace posterior decisions with transmitted symbols. A null result shows only that this receiver’s refit did not improve with those anchors.

stages.title: Combiner refit
stages.detail: Ridge refit of the partial-FFT combiner W toward the anchors. Data-anchor confidence values weight the refit. Lite refits W only; the physical response C is never formed.

stages.title: Re-decode
stages.detail: The refit combiner re-equalizes the partial-FFT views, belief propagation re-decodes a fresh candidate, and payload extraction returns payload-bit estimates.

stages.title: Candidate selection
stages.detail: Keep the best candidate by LDPC validity, syndrome weight, selection score with its margin, then posterior magnitude. Stop on success, non-improvement, or the iteration limit.

stages.title: Frame-wide FEC receiver
stages.detail: One LDPC belief-propagation graph spans the requested frame. The selected frame receiver processes all block observations before payload metrics are returned.

stages.title: C,z refinement
stages.detail: C,z refinement first computes the OFDM+FEC and frame-wide Lite candidates. With zero update steps it returns frame-wide Lite. C is updated given z; W is derived from C or updated by the selected form. The joint C,W,z form uses an analytical gradient for bounded simultaneous updates. Belief propagation checks the candidates, and CRC when present can gate replacement of the frame-wide Lite result.
